highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: SonicWall releases patches for 7 flaws in its firewalls, most involving unauthenticated access and Microsoft’s email security is unexpectedly blocking legitimate business mail. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: France blames Iran for supermarket hack meltdowns. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: York University discloses data breach affecting departmental forms. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
